a.lede: The South Korean government used extra measures to prevent cheating in its national college admission exams, due to a confession from a tax accountant exam top scorer admitting to AI-assisted cheating days before the CSAT.
a.title: South Korea busts 54 students cheating on national college admission exam by deploying emergency disaster alert during test

b.lede: Choi Kyo-jin said he ‘failed to prepare adequately’ for entrance exams, which this year had phones banned and checks for cameras hidden in clothing South Korea’s education minister resigned on Sunday after an AI-assisted cheating scandal that erupted in the lead-up to the country’s key university entrance exams. The country has been gripped by fears of AI-assisted exam cheating since
b.title: South Korea education minister resigns after AI cheating scandal engulfs university exams
